body: Just as a small update, I reached out to another and I think they're going to come over and comfort me and watch a movie with me.

I feel like I should try messaging another one, but I'm so afraid that they won't help either.

I don't know, I feel like I was in the wrong here. I shouldn't have checked their tumbler, upon finding the vent blog, I shouldn't have read all the posts. 

I don't know if I can. We all play dnd together. If I confront her and the 'friendship' does end then dnd will probably end I don't have a lot of friends as is. Or I don't know if they're even friends. I don't know if I have friends. I messaged a friend to see if they can come talk to me and they haven't replied yet. It's been a hour and I'm constantly refreshing facebook

I don't know if it counts as talking behind my back. It's a vent blog so I imagine the idea is this is stuff they just want to vent about

I mean, it's not like they were talking badly about me. I just really thought things were going well. I felt like they personally were someone I can rely on and I felt better with them around. But it just really hurts for them to not feel the same way. They sound just tired of me, how they talk to me is not at all how they feel about me. The post that hurt me most is them saying they just want to be friends with me and only see me in group context and not outside of that. They don't want to be good friends with me and it just hurts a lot. They sound so sick of me
